ideas.pitch: An AI-powered Discord community intelligence tool that summarizes server activity, flags unanswered questions, and surfaces high-value discussions for event hosts in real-time.
ideas.title: AdmitiyDiscordPulse
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeted directly at the Discord hosting format of the hackathon, making event moderation and engagement analysis significantly easier for the organizers.

ideas.pitch: A lightning-fast portfolio and project card generator designed specifically for 12-hour hackathons, allowing participants to package their Discord submissions into interactive live demos with one click.
ideas.title: VibeShare
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the 'Build something worth sharing' tagline perfectly by solving the friction of packaging and submitting projects within a tight 12-hour window.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multi-agent study buddy that ingests reference documents shared in student Discord channels and instantly generates adaptive quizzes and structured revision flashcards.
ideas.title: StudyVibeAI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages proven patterns from educational tech hackathon winners by combining multi-agent flows with immediate, actionable assessment outputs.

ideas.pitch: A micro-wellness assistant optimized for intense 12-hour sprints that monitors screen time, prompts healthy stretches, and delivers personalized nutritious snack and meal ideas.
ideas.title: VibeCheck Health & Wellness
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the immediate physical constraints of a high-intensity 12-hour sprint with an engaging, practical utility tool that judges testing the hackathon can relate to.

ideas.pitch: An automated repository compliance checker that inspects submissions for proper license attribution, third-party resource disclosures, and AI usage documentation.
ideas.title: CodeVibeAudit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly automates the specific rules and disclosure requirements laid out in the hackathon guidelines, providing immediate utility to event organizers.
